snippet.title: Pixel Solo Ops | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Pixel Solo Ops is a retro-inspired 2D action-platformer. After a covert mission goes wrong, your closest comrade is captured by a ruthless military faction. Fight through enemy troops, infiltrate fortified bases, and survive intense pixel-art firefights to rescue him. With tight gunplay, fast-paced challenges, and nostalgic visuals, you’re the last hope. One soldier. One mission. No backup.
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/pixel-solo-ops-xbox-series/9n26sl9xwkcq
